findings.claim: The new acceptance regex `(^|[^\w-])gentle-ai([^\w-]|$)` treats `.` and `/` as word boundaries. It will also match a labdrian-own overlay command that carries a path or argument such as `~/.gentle-ai/...` or `/gentle-ai/` (a directory name, not the binary). The acceptance text says it matches `gentle-ai`, not `gentle-ai-overlay`, but it does not say how such false positives are handled. The check could then fail on commands that should stay, or push the implementer to edit the overlay commands. The previous wording (first token basename) did not have this ambiguity. This is speculative, because no such command is shown in the diff.

evidence: The only changed path is the feature document; the diff modifies the S17 acceptance text and appends the L24 log entry.
The regex excludes `-` and word characters on both sides, so it correctly does not match `gentle-ai-overlay`.
L24 lists 7 findings, and the per-commit counts in the entry (2 + 4 + 1) add up to 7.
The commit hashes cited in L24 (e.g. `2a8dae6e`) cannot be checked from the diff, so I raised no finding on them.
